action.needsLauncher: Editing an archive needs the launcher

dialog.title: Edit {{file}}
dialog.readOnlyText: This archive can be read here but not changed.
dialog.closeBody: The archive has changes that are not saved. Closing the editor throws them away.
dialog.discardBody: Every change since the last save goes back to what the archive holds.

toolbar.addFilesRootTitle: Add files to the root of the archive
toolbar.extractAllHint: Extract the whole archive into a folder on the disk
toolbar.extractOneHint: Extract {{name}} into a folder on the disk
toolbar.extractTitle: Choose the folder to extract into

tree.label: Entries of the archive
tree.moreMatches: The first {{shown}} of {{count}} matches are listed. Narrow the search to see the rest.

rename.title: Rename {{name}}
rename.body: The path inside the archive, with forward slashes. A folder moves with everything under it.
rename.label: New path
rename.invalid: The path has to be relative, without a leading slash, without “..”, and at most 260 characters.
rename.unchanged: The path is the same as before.

newFolder.title: New folder
newFolder.body: The folder appears in the tree at once and is written into the archive when a file is added to it: an archive holds files, not empty folders.
newFolder.label: Folder name
newFolder.inRoot: At the root of the archive
newFolder.invalid: A folder name cannot be empty, contain a slash or “..”, or be longer than 260 characters.
newFolder.exists: A folder with this name is already there.

entry.pick: Pick an entry or a folder to see it here.
entry.removed: This entry is marked for removal. Discard the changes to bring it back.
entry.pendingText: The text differs from the archive. Apply writes it into the session; Save writes the archive.
entry.truncated: Only the beginning of the file is shown: it is too large to edit here. Replace it with a file from the disk instead.
entry.replaceImageHint: The picture is converted to the format of the entry, so the path the game looks up stays the same.
entry.replaceHint: A file from the disk takes the place of this entry.
entry.imageFailed: The picture could not be decoded.

folder.pending: Empty folder. It is written into the archive when a file is added to it.
